scope: Every About > Licenses entry, resolved release/debug runtime artifacts, incorporated source, core library desugaring, and the FFmpeg binary used by the converter.
method: Resolved both runtime classpaths and coreLibraryDesugaring offline with Gradle; inspected cached exact-version binary/source archives and POMs.
Verified license/NOTICE files at version tags or incorporated-source commits where available; listed primary upstream sources per entry.
Individual source copyright headers can have different dates and owners; the family summary does not replace those original notices.
No automatic extension of years to 2026; no dates inferred from an inceptionYear, release date, repository creation date or license-document copyright.
Debug-only rows are excluded from release. Presence in a runtime graph is conservative attribution evidence and does not prove every class survives release shrinking.
limitations: This is an audit of the About list and the Java/Android dependency graph, not a complete recursive SBOM or source-offer/relinking compliance audit of Rust crates inside the FCast native SDK, FFmpeg internals, JDK internals or every other library implementation.
Source-only upstream project-family credits summarize retained code and contributors; per-file notices in the source remain authoritative.
